Mobile 375: no horizontal overflow on landing. Branding scan on visible text of / and /app: 0 occurrences of NullCash, Veil, 'out of sight', @usecamocash. ONE BUG FOUND & FIXED by testing agent: /app/frontend/src/components/NmNav.jsx had X_URL='https://x.com/usecamocash' — spec requires @trycamocash. All anchors derive from this constant so hero-x, cta-x, landing-footer X and app header dk-x-link were all wrong. Fixed in-place; re-verified: both hero-x and cta-x now resolve to https://x.com/trycamocash and /app header dk-x-link also points to trycamocash. The paraphrased copy ('Follow @trycamocash') was already correct.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. /app/frontend/src/components/NmNav.jsx exported X_URL='https://x.com/usecamocash' which propagated to hero-x, cta-x, landing-footer and the /app header X icon. Spec #5 requires https://x.com/trycamocash (@trycamocash). Dk-swap.js was already correct (@trycamocash) so the two surfaces disagreed. One-line change: X_URL='https://x.com/trycamocash'. Re-tested — all X anchors on / and /app now resolve to trycamocash.

issues: Residual 'veil' tokens still present in /app HTML as CSS variable NAMES (--veil-fg, --veil-hi, --veil-deep, --veil-wash) and in link selectors (a[href*='github.com/veil'], a[href*='@veilit.xyz']). Three nav labels (Earn, Invite, 'Security review ↗') are rendered in the DOM but hidden via display:none / zero-size parent (.side-audit). They do not reach the user, but shipping dead markup bloats the nav HTML. Consider removing from the source template rather than hiding.

action_items: No further action required for @trycamocash — testing agent already fixed NmNav.jsx. Consider adding a one-line regression test (e.g. assert X_URL endswith '/trycamocash') to prevent future drift.

(Optional, non-blocking) Rename --veil-* CSS variables in /app/backend/brand/nc-theme.css + dk-swap.js to --camo-* to eliminate the ~33 raw 'veil' tokens still visible in /app HTML source. Flagged as accepted residual by main agent — leaving as-is.
(Optional) Strip Earn/Invite/'Security review' nodes from the source nav template instead of hiding via .side-audit so the DOM matches the final design.
critical_code_review_comments: NmNav.jsx vs dk-swap.js diverged on X_URL (usecamocash vs trycamocash). Two files holding the same brand constant is a latent drift risk — consider importing the handle from a single source (e.g. a brand/constants.js module) consumed by both landing React code and the dk-swap overlay.

/app/backend/bifrost.py: CHUNK_VER forward rewrite and _CHUNK_ALIAS_RE reverse regex are still decoupled constants after iter32's one-line fix. Deriving the regex from CHUNK_VER directly would prevent recurrence of the iter32 blank-splash incident on any future version bump.
/app/backend/brand/dk-swap.js remains ~1300 lines and is the single largest file in the brand overlay — overdue for a split (splash, nav, tour, panels).

rca of the issue: RCA for @usecamocash leak: NmNav.jsx held the sole X_URL constant used by the landing React component and the /app header overlay re-reads it independently via dk-swap.js. iter32's X-handle update was applied to dk-swap.js only; NmNav.jsx was missed because it lives in /app/frontend/src and the brand overlay rewrite path never touches the React source tree. Reproduction: curl / | grep usecamocash matches 3 times (hero-x, cta-x, footer). Fix: single-line edit to X_URL. Prevention: centralise brand constants into one file (/app/brand/constants.js) imported by both NmNav.jsx and dk-swap.js so the handle cannot drift again.
